body:
Adds `research/windup-twin` (companion to `lag-twin`): a PI loop on an integrator with a command limit U and constant load d versus a twin with neither. Stylised, pure Python, 7 tests, results from `experiments/results.txt`.

- Twin is exact iff kp·x0 ≤ U; beyond it the integrator winds up to exactly x0²/(2U); overshoot 21% → 97%, settling 4.9 → 944.
- Loads d ≥ U are never rejected; faster twin-tuned gains settle slower; conditional integration recovers most.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (173 projects).
